body.deadline_description: Final pay timing strict (10 days or regular payday): Idaho Code § 45-606 requires wages by the earlier of the next regular payday or 10 days after termination; employee request for early payment triggers 48-hour deadline (weekends/holidays excluded).

citation.note: Non-competes enforceable with limits: Idaho Code §§ 44-2701, 44-2704 enforce non-competes for "key employees" only if reasonable in duration (18 months max, presumed reasonable if ≤18 months), geography, and scope...

body.rule: Non-competes enforceable with limits: Idaho Code §§ 44-2701, 44-2704 enforce non-competes for "key employees" only if reasonable in duration (18 months max, presumed reasonable if ≤18 months), geography, and scope; must protect legitimate business interests; violations of restraint doctrine may result in unenforceability.

citation.note: Wage deductions restricted: Deductions only permitted if required by law or with written employee authorization (Idaho Code § 45-609); must provide itemized statement of deductions; unpaid wages accrue 15-day penalty...
